ideas.title: Uncovering the Extent of Medicaid Fraud
ideas.description: Investigate the scope of Medicaid fraud, including the entities and individuals involved, and the amounts of money lost to fraudulent activities.
ideas.angle: Data analysis and investigation of Medicaid fraud cases
questions: What is the total amount of money lost to Medicaid fraud?
Which entities and individuals are involved in the fraud?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to expose a significant issue that affects the healthcare system and taxpayers. By analyzing data and investigating cases, we can uncover the extent of the fraud and identify areas for improvement.
